Step 3. By the degenerate spectral theorem, we decompose \(S_{01380013} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the degenerate spectral family.

Conclusion. The result follows by combining Steps 1-3 through Fourier approximation and the compactness of the spectral family.
